def: properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land

occurrences.text: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
For thus saith the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
